title: Talent
description: One base ability or talent of a sphere. Canonical mechanical record consumed by the character builder. Never inferred from the DOM at runtime.

id.description: Stable unique slug within the whole dataset (e.g. 'mente-encanto'). Referenced by prerequisites and class grants.

kind.description: 'base' = base ability granted with sphere access; 'talent' = an optional pick.

group.description: Originating h3 group heading in the source (drives free-pick classification). Empty for base abilities.

tags.description: Normalized parenthetical tags from the source name, e.g. ['genotipo'], ['encanto'].

prerequisites.description: References the rules engine checks before allowing this talent.

advanced.description: True if the talent has prerequisites / belongs to an advanced or legendary group.

body.description: Talent prose (Homebrewery/Markdown). Source for the future structured reader render (Phase 5).

_needsReview.description: Migration marker: fields the extractor could not infer confidently. Must be cleared before a sphere is marked reviewed.

cost.description: Structured magic-point cost. Captures tiered costs like '0PM (menor), 1PM (maior), 2PM (poderoso)'.

base.description: Flat PM cost, or null when variable / expressed only as tiers.

text.description: Original prose cost, for display and audit.

id.description: Referenced talent or sphere id (required for type talent/sphere).

of.description: Alternativas do OR-group (type or) — satisfeito se QUALQUER uma satisfaz.

tags.description: Tags aceitas (type tag) — conta talentos possuídos com qualquer uma.

count.description: Nº mínimo de talentos com a(s) tag(s) (type tag).

sphere.description: Id da esfera do pacote (type package).

pm.description: Extra PM cost of the enhancement.
